| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spatial sigma** `sigmaSpatial` | 30 | 1 to 200 px | The sigma H of the smoothing in the stretched domain, like the spatial sigma of a bilateral filter. 30 is our choice. |
| **Color sigma** `sigmaColor` | 80 | 1 to 255 levels | The sigma r that says how large a color change counts as an edge. 80 is our choice. |
| **Mode** `mode` | Normalized convolution | Normalized convolution, Interpolated convolution, Recursive filter | The 1-D filter of the paper. Normalized convolution averages a box in the stretched domain, interpolated convolution averages the interpolated signal, and the recursive filter is an exponential filter. OpenCV uses normalized convolution. |
| **Passes** `iterations` | 3 | 1 to 10 | How many times the rows and columns are filtered, each pass with a smaller sigma. OpenCV uses 3. |
